description: Change the enforcement mode of an existing budget or pause/resume it. Use "alert_only" for monitoring, "soft_block" for overridable limits, or "hard_block" for strict enforcement. Do NOT use to create new budgets — use set_budget for that.

budget_id.description: The budget configuration ID to update

paused.description: Set to true to pause the budget, false to resume

name: metrx_update_budget_mode
title: Update Budget Mode
